prs.title: Fixes for rotational periodic boundaries: implicit solver, multigrid and limiters
Fix periodic axis geometry, slip normals and moving donor volumes
Fix periodic neighbor counts, intersecting stencils and coarse flags
Fix streamwise periodic heat, massflow and auxiliary gradients
Fix inverse periodic affine transforms in the parser and FEM
Reject unsupported periodic adjoint, radiation and structural solvers
Search translated wall images when computing periodic wall distance
